description: This Java class handles the submission of savings account application commands within the Fineract project. It implements command processing logic for creating savings accounts, delegating the core operation to the SavingsApplicationProcessWritePlatformService.

classes.name: SavingsAccountApplicationSubmittalCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the command to submit savings account applications by invoking the corresponding service method.

methods.name: SavingsAccountApplicationSubmittalCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the savings application processing service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to create a savings account by delegating to the service.
